name: Kajabi
description: Kajabi lets agents read and manage products, courses, contacts, and offers in the signed-in Kajabi site. It cannot take payments or send email broadcasts.

prompts.text: List my products and courses and how many members each one has.
Which contacts joined in the last 30 days?
Draft an outline for a new course module about pricing.

apps.name: Kajabi
apps.description: Products, courses, contacts, and offers, over Kajabi's MCP server with browser sign-in.
